Double counting proves 3234 projective rays, and free modulation gives 66 orbits. The embedded Python program was executed and supplies the exact integer certificate, including rank-three essential-column verification; no numerical approximation enters the proof.

The invariant is motivated by the exact sparse Fourier uncertainty problem in the source paper and its distinction from global MUB minima. This is a complete finite geometric classification, not an arbitrary parameter perturbation, and its validity does not require an unproved extension to larger primes.
